Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Supersaiyane
Message:
feat: TASK-P2-006, the AMG connection strategy

Discovery over ListWorkspaces per account and region, paginated, with a token
minted per read and revoked in a finally. The prototype left service accounts
behind when a run died half way; minting is a loan, not an allocation.

A region that could not be listed becomes a visible unreachable instance rather
than a shorter list. Nothing downstream can tell that a region was meant to be
there, so a silently smaller estate is worse here than almost anywhere else.

The import contract refused the first implementation. finops_query sits above
finops_providers because it reads what an adapter fetched, so classifying inside
the adapter inverted the layers. The adapter now names a QueryParser port in
finops_core and a collector supplies the implementation.

An alert rule's intervalSeconds is a number, and refresh_seconds parses Grafana
duration strings, so passing one to the other returned zero. An alert that runs
every minute would have been reported as one that never runs, and an alert is
usually the largest term in a cost figure.

moto implements no Grafana operation at all, so the contract suite runs under
botocore.stub, which validates against the real service model and caught the
fixture omitting four fields ListWorkspaces requires. ISS-141.
